_readme: THE PRE-OWNED LISTINGS. This file is the only place a pre-owned boat is entered, changed or retired.
To add, change or sell a boat: edit the list below, then run   perl _build/gen_preowned.pl
That writes /pre-owned/<slug>/index.html for every boat, redraws the cards on /pre-owned/, removes the
page of any boat no longer listed here (or marked sold), re-stamps assets, canonicals and the sitemap.
Photos live in assets/preowned/<slug>/NN.jpg (+ thumbs/NN.jpg), NN = 01..n; `n` is the photo count.
`desc` is the seller's own write-up, one string per paragraph (recovered from the web archive of the
old WordPress listings, 2026-10-28). Leave a field "" rather than guessing; empty fields are skipped.
`url` is the old WordPress listing the entry was captured from: provenance only, never rendered.
The order below is the order on the page. sold:true hides the boat and takes its page down.
